claim: Two leading OnlyFans statistics aggregators give median creator earnings that differ by roughly an order of magnitude — SirenCY states a median of $145/month (~$1,740/year) while onlyfansstatistics.com states ~$180/year — demonstrating that the circulating OnlyFans median has no stable value.
stance_target: The claim that a reliable median OnlyFans creator income figure exists in the public statistics layer
scope_conditions: OnlyFans only; both figures published 2026; SirenCY attributes its figure to 'OnlyFans' own data plus industry research' without naming either, giving no sample size, year, method or country; SirenCY is a commercial OnlyFans management agency selling services to creators, so has a direct incentive to depict a beatable median
quoted_support: OnlyFans' own data plus industry research show median creator earnings around $145-180/month. This number includes inactive creators (registered but not posting).

claim: SirenCY states the OnlyFans top 1% earns over 70% of total creator revenue, more than double the ~33% top-1% share published by onlyfansstatistics.com for the same platform and year.
stance_target: The claim that the OnlyFans top-1% revenue-share figure is a settled statistic
scope_conditions: No sample size, source study, year or country given for either figure; SirenCY's percentile bands are stated as ranges without underlying data; note that ~73% is elsewhere reported as the top-10% share, suggesting SirenCY may have mislabelled a decile figure as a percentile figure
quoted_support: Heavy concentration at top tier by design - 1% earns 70%+ of total creator revenue.

claim: SirenCY reports that median earnings among ACTIVE OnlyFans creators (posting weekly or more) are roughly $1,000-1,500/month versus $145/month across all registered accounts — an approximately 7-10x gap created purely by excluding inactive accounts from the denominator.
stance_target: The claim that survivorship bias and denominator choice, not measurement error, drive most of the variance in reported creator income
scope_conditions: No sample size or method disclosed; 'active' defined as posting weekly or more; source is a management agency whose clients are by definition active creators, so the active-creator figure is likely drawn from its own client base rather than a representative sample
quoted_support: Average mixes creators who post weekly with creators who registered and never posted. Use median for healthier benchmark. Active-creator median is more useful: ~$1,000-3,000/month for committed creators with niche-fit positioning.

claim: SirenCY places OnlyFans creator attrition in months 3-6 — 'most failures happen between months 3-6' — and states first-6-month solo earnings of $100-1,500/month, but provides no cohort data, sample size or survival curve to support either.
stance_target: The claim that creator attrition concentrates in the first six months
scope_conditions: Agency marketing copy; no cohort definition, no n, no observation window, no country; 'failure' is undefined (ceasing to post vs ceasing to earn); directionally consistent with survival findings on other platforms but carries no independent evidentiary weight
quoted_support: First 6 months solo: $100-1,500/month average. Agency-managed: $500-3,000/month. The variance comes from niche fit, consistency, and traffic strategy. Most failures happen between months 3-6.

claim: SirenCY's staged earnings ramp implies time-to-meaningful-income on OnlyFans of 12-18 months unmanaged, compressed to 4-9 months with agency management, with months 1-3 earning $0-500 solo.
stance_target: The claim about how long creators take to reach meaningful income
scope_conditions: Stated by an agency that sells the compression service being quantified — a direct conflict of interest; no sample size, no definition of 'meaningful income', no country; the accompanying claim that agency-managed creators earn 2-3x solo equivalents 'even after 20-40% commission' is the source's own sales proposition
quoted_support: Agency operations (24/7 chatters, traffic, content strategy) compress the timeline to meaningful income from 12-18 months solo to 4-9 months agency.

claim: SirenCY's disclosed scale is 312+ creators supported and $50M+ 'revenue influenced', figures which describe its client book rather than any research sample, confirming that none of its earnings statistics rest on a defined study population.
stance_target: The claim that agency-published creator earnings statistics constitute research evidence
scope_conditions: Self-reported marketing metrics on a sales landing page; 'revenue influenced' is undefined and not equivalent to creator earnings; the page's stated purpose is recruiting creators to the agency ('Apply to SirenCY')
quoted_support: 312+ Creators Supported $50M+ Revenue Influenced 24–48h Review Window
